p.s: I agree that shopping is not always ejoyable because a lot of things could occur you.
I remember when I was younger I used to go with my mom shopping to the stores but I did not like it, because I found boring to buy clothes spending a lot of hours in a commercial centre.
Another bad thing could be the enormous queues in the supermarkets, it is incredible how many time you can spend in there.
The last month was a robbery in a commercial centre next to my house, somebody stole a lady's purse with all her identifications, credit cards and cash, even more her flight ticket.
Therefore she had to do a lot of tramits to cancell their credit cards and to change her flight ticket.
To sum up I would say that even when shopping is not always enjoyable we have to do it because we do not have another option.
